answer: The admission bond is time locked for 6 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are logged in hollow, expire in ledge, and pulse lists each expiry. An adversary running 189 aliases therefore needs 150 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4958 identities would post 3818 proofs and burn roughly 67 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
